request.raw_text: Add cylindrical pin into the bearing area of the part, so it is able to rotate around it.

aim.primary_aim: The final model should contain a cylindrical pin in the part's bearing area that permits the part to rotate around the pin.

functional_design_intentions.name: Enable rotation
functional_design_intentions.description: Permit the part to rotate around the cylindrical pin at the bearing area.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: cylindrical pin in the bearing area of the part

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: bearing area and all other non-targeted geometry of the part
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing part geometry while adding the pin, and retain the bearing area's ability to support rotation around the pin.

geometry.description: One cylindrical pin exists in the bearing area of the part.

functions.name: Provide rotational support
functions.description: The cylindrical pin provides an axis around which the part can rotate at the bearing area.

behaviors.name: Permit rotation around pin
behaviors.description: The part is able to undergo rotational motion around the cylindrical pin.

validation_criteria.description: Exactly one cylindrical pin is present in the bearing area of the part.
The pin provides a rotational axis for the part at the bearing area.
The part can rotate around the cylindrical pin.
Non-targeted part geometry remains unchanged, and the bearing area retains its intended rotational role.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact bearing area and pin placement are not identified by model IDs or geometric references.
candidate_interpretations: Place the pin through an existing bearing opening.
Place the pin at the rotational center of the referenced bearing region.

unresolved_requirements.description: The pin diameter, length, fit, and rotational clearance are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Size the pin from the existing bearing-area geometry with clearance sufficient for rotation.
Use a specified standard pin size and fit.

unresolved_requirements.description: The pin's attachment and component status are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: The pin is a separate component fixed relative to an external support while the part rotates around it.
The pin is included as separate geometry within the model or assembly.
The pin is integral to another supporting component.
